item.title: Camden County Release Reentry Center — 'Places Like This Give You Hope' - NJ PEN
item.description: Formerly incarcerated people can't quickly acclimate to life outside of prison. A new program builds in supportive transitional services at the time of release to help them return home for good.

item.title: After Year of Upheaval, Jersey Kebab Family Immigration Cases No Closer to Resolution - NJ PEN
item.description: ‘The media wants to portray a sad beginning and a happy ending, but that’s not what we have now,’ says Muhammed Emanet, whose family has been fighting for its U.S. citizenship for 20 years. Emanet, who is married to a U.S. citizen, is waiting for his green card. He now has a final deportation hearing scheduled for December.

item.title: Haddonfield Barricaded Person Taken Into Protective Custody, No Charges Pending - NJ PEN
item.description: Haddonfield Police, Fire, and the Camden County Sheriff's Emergency Response Team (SERT) peacefully resolved a tense situation Wednesday morning.

item.title: Audubon Approves Flagship Carwash Redevelopment - NJ PEN
item.description: The project will transform the vacant commercial building at the White Horse Pike and Kings Highway into a car wash facility from Spotless Car Wash Brands.

item.title: Haddon Heights Sets Terms for Auctioning First Liquor License in Borough History - NJ PEN
item.description: Borough council introduces the terms of its alcohol license auction at its March 17 meeting. The municipality could approve an operator by June, which would be required to activate the license within six months.

item.title: The Garb Collection: Conservationist Consignment Comes to Collingswood - NJ PEN
item.description: Caitlin Quirk leverages a degree in fashion design to bring a sustainability approach to second-hand shopping. Her new Collingswood storefront embraces a mission to keep useable clothes out of landfills.

item.title: Café 1903: Italian Coffee Shop Opens in Former Collingswood Fire Station - NJ PEN
item.description: The first piece of redevelopment of the historic borough fire building to come online, the café offers an espresso bar, lounge area, and outdoor patio. Ends of the Earth, an attached tobacco shop that is open to the public, will follow next month, as will a private, members-only club.

item.title: Prosecution Rests in Trial of Collingswood Teen Accused of Manslaughter - NJ PEN
item.description: Luke Humphrey is charged with manslaughter in the death of Oron Carl “Snook” Beebe, Jr.

item.title: Collingswood Teenager Accused of Manslaughter Claims Family Threatened Before He Threw Punch - NJ PEN
item.description: Luke Humphrey testified in his own defense Thursday, along with his mother, Meghan, and other character witnesses.

item.title: From Hollywood to Haddon Heights: Broz’s Booch House Delivers Tapas Dining on Station Ave. - NJ PEN
item.description: Michael Broz started brewing his own kombucha as part of his wellness routine. Now he’s serving the fermented health drinks alongside tapas-style dishes from Chef Marco Passante in a stylish Station Avenue dining room.
